applicability.reason: A complete selected Apple downloads instance is parsed, saved with source provenance, read back, and completed atomically with its leased worker job.
Closed provider/options validation rejects partial or unselected report inventory before segment download.
Connection rotation after read and a synthetic SQLite write failure prevent partition persistence and leave a bounded blocked result.
Partition rows and successful job result commit in one current-lease transaction; stale or changed connection state is not accepted.
Agent allowlist, current connection hash, app scope, secret and signed-URL redaction, bounded endpoint, and safe provider errors are covered.
Segment count/byte and parser/storage size limits are enforced before expensive download or persistence.
This backend-only slice changes no visible interface, keyboard behavior, or assistive-technology output.
Provider report discovery and signed downloads are read effects. Local tests mock them and assert the bounded read-only transport contract; a live account read is not claimed.

checks.requirement: Fetch and persist only the explicitly selected complete daily App Downloads Standard instance; save its source-bound partitions and job completion atomically.
Reject unsupported provider/options and partial, missing, unselected, or non-daily report instances before accepting metrics.
On connection rotation or SQLite failure, persist no metric partition and record a sanitized blocked job result.
Require the same app, connection version/hash, agent policy, lease and attempt at persistence; keep partitions and job completion in one transaction.
Do not expose credentials or signed URLs; allow only the bounded analytics read for agents and keep result scope app-bound.
Enforce transport, segment, parser, decompression, partition and per-app storage limits.
Use only permitted read requests; signed segment requests omit API authorization and block redirects. Live Apple calls remain unrun.
